MRVL.pe_narrative: MRVL re-rated from ~25-30x fwd earnings in 2024 to 60-80x+ through 2025-26 as hyperscaler custom-silicon wins (Amazon, Microsoft, Google) and Nvidia's $2B NVLink Fusion stake fed a 'chip supercycle' story, peaking after Huang's June 2026 'trillion-dollar company' remark. The multiple has since compressed sharply (-49% in a month) as the $115B all-stock Lumentum bid stoked dilution and antitrust-timeline fears that overshadowed raised FY27/FY28 revenue guides.
